name: Storage - Default (seed v1)
description: A place that holds items: a structure's output, a warehouse, a player's inbox or stash, a clan vault (stock core P1, #97). Stock moves only through the ledger (adjust and move dialogs), never through this form.

steps.description: Name it and pick its kind and its holder. Fill only the holder field that matches the kind; a transit storage has none.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: At most 100 characters, e.g. "Docks warehouse" or "Inbox".

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: Domain = a structure, town or district; Player = a player's inbox, stash or vault; Clan = a clan vault; Transit = the cargo of a transport order. Kind and holder can't change once the storage has stock or history.

fields.label: Domain
fields.description: For kind Domain: the structure, town or district that holds it.

fields.label: Player
fields.description: For kind Player: the player who holds it.

fields.label: Clan
fields.description: For kind Clan: the clan that holds it.

steps.description: Caps count raw units × each item's storage weight (default 1). Leave a cap empty for no cap. Lowering a cap below the stock only stops new stock coming in.

fields.label: Max units
fields.description: Raw units the storage holds at most (Σ amount × storage weight). Empty = no cap. Transit storages have no cap.

fields.label: Max distinct items
fields.description: How many different items (stock lines plus unique items) it holds at most. Empty = no cap.

fields.label: Units per container slot
fields.description: For storages with bound containers (later phase): cap = bound slots × this. Not used yet.

fields.label: Locked until
fields.description: While in the future, nothing moves in or out (sync conflicts, sieges, investigations). Empty = not locked.

fields.label: Lock reason
fields.description: Why it is locked, at most 200 characters.
